Reading milestone states

Proposed
Scope still needs agreement.
Ready
Defined and available to start.
In progress
Active work is underway.
Blocked
A stated dependency prevents progress.
Done
The recorded milestone is complete.

Recorded complete means all listed Milestones are done. Broader Hero or Goal work may still be unrecorded. Partially complete means some listed Milestones are done and none is currently in progress.
